tools.name: restaking-risk_cross-network-slashing-exposure
tools.description: Calculate unique collateral, gross exposure, and overlap when caller-supplied vault collateral is reused across networks. Simultaneous scenarios slash the starting balance and cap the combined percent at 100%. Sequential scenarios reduce the remaining balance after each event. audit_status is calcul

tools.name: restaking-risk_slashing-correlation
tools.description: Cap each operator's network weights at 100 percent of its stake, then weight that exposure by stake. The correlation score is the share of stake that sits on more than one network. Weights are the caller's risk weights. No stake is fetched. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/restaking-risk/slashing-corr

tools.name: restaking-risk_slashing-window-feasibility
tools.description: Compare caller-supplied slashing stages with an available window. Each duration is an integer in seconds, or in epochs when its unit is epochs. Epoch length is seconds. Stages run in detection, evidence, submission, veto, execution, and finality order. Consecutive stages listed in parallel start tog

tools.name: restaking-risk_exit-window
tools.description: Subtract the unbonding time and the withdrawal delay from the soonest caller-supplied slash horizon. The buffer is that remainder in hours. The feasibility score is the buffer divided by the soonest horizon, and it is zero when the buffer is negative. No queue is read from a network. Price $0.04 USD

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "restaking-risk" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: restaking-risk_exit-window · Private data: restaking-risk_cross-network-slashing-exposure · Public sink: restaking-risk_cross-network-slashing-exposure, restaking-risk_slashing-correlation, restaking-risk_slashing-window-feasibility, restaking-risk_exit-window · Destructive: restaking-risk_cross-network-slashing-exposure, restaking-risk_slashing-correlation, restaking-risk_slashing-window-feasibility, restaking-risk_exit-window.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: restaking-risk_exit-window · Private data: restaking-risk_cross-network-slashing-exposure · Public sink: restaking-risk_cross-network-slashing-exposure, restaking-risk_slashing-correlation, restaking-risk_slashing-window-feasibility, restaking-risk_exit-window · Destructive: restaking-risk_cross-network-slashing-exposure, restaking-risk_slashing-correlation, restaking-risk_slashing-window-feasibility, restaking-risk_exit-window

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
